id: Rotom Dex: That didn't take too long. Let's visit some other friends today. Kiawe might be at the farm.
en: Rotom Dex: That didn't take too long. Let's visit some other friends today. Kiawe might be at the farm.
it: Rotom Dex: Non ci è voluto molto. Andiamo a trovare qualche altro amico oggi. Kiawe potrebbe essere alla fattoria.

id: \bMy friend is looking for nectar right now. Don't think I'm gonna let you steal it.
en: \bMy friend is looking for nectar right now. Don't think I'm gonna let you steal it.
it: \bIl mio amico sta cercando del nettare proprio ora. Non pensare che ti lascerò rubarlo.

id: \bSophocles: You want to help me rescue the Ultra Beast? Too bad this one is mine.
en: \bSophocles: You want to help me rescue the Ultra Beast? Too bad this one is mine.
it: \bChrys: Vuoi aiutarmi a salvare l'Ultracreatura? Peccato, questa è mia.

id: \bSophocles: I guess you can take this one.
en: \bSophocles: I guess you can take this one.
it: \bChrys: Va bene, questa puoi prenderla tu.

id: \bI'm getting ready for my island trail.
en: \bI'm getting ready for my island trail.
it: \bMi sto preparando per la mia prova dell'isola.

id: \bYou're challenging it too! No wonder I lost.
en: \bYou're challenging it too! No wonder I lost.
it: \bAnche tu la stai affrontando! Ecco perché ho perso.

id: \rMallow: Good to see you \PN. I need to find some nectar for a recipe of mine. It should be in the meadow next to us.
en: \rMallow: Good to see you \PN. I need to find some nectar for a recipe of mine. It should be in the meadow next to us.
it: \rIbis: Che bello vederti, \PN. Devo trovare del nettare per una mia ricetta. Dovrebbe essere nel prato qui accanto.

id: \rMallow: Good job getting the nectar. You can keep that one. I found my own. My Bounsweet actually evolved in the process. Let me show you.
en: \rMallow: Good job getting the nectar. You can keep that one. I found my own. My Bounsweet actually evolved in the process. Let me show you.
it: \rIbis: Bravo, hai preso il nettare. Puoi tenerlo. Io ho trovato il mio. E intanto il mio Bounsweet si è evoluto. Lascia che te lo mostri.

id: \rMallow: That's all I had for you. Thanks \PN.
en: \rMallow: That's all I had for you. Thanks \PN.
it: \rIbis: È tutto quello che avevo per te. Grazie, \PN.

id: \bNo one is going to stop me.
en: \bNo one is going to stop me.
it: \bNessuno mi fermerà.

id: \bI can't slow down. It goes against my nature.
en: \bI can't slow down. It goes against my nature.
it: \bNon posso rallentare. È contro la mia natura.

id: Rotom Dex: Great work. Let's head back to the school.
en: Rotom Dex: Great work. Let's head back to the school.
it: Rotom Dex: Ottimo lavoro. Torniamo a scuola.

id: \rWhere are all the Raticate?
en: \rWhere are all the Raticate?
it: \rDove sono finiti tutti i Raticate?

id: \rNever stop looking. They all show up eventually.
en: \rNever stop looking. They all show up eventually.
it: \rNon smettere mai di cercare. Prima o poi saltano fuori tutti.

id: \bEver seen my show?
en: \bEver seen my show?
it: \bHai mai visto il mio spettacolo?

id: \bIt's a great show. Really, stop what you're doing and go see it.
en: \bIt's a great show. Really, stop what you're doing and go see it.
it: \bÈ uno spettacolo fantastico. Davvero, molla tutto e vai a vederlo.

id: \bThey call me Dragon Rage.
en: \bThey call me Dragon Rage.
it: \bMi chiamano Ira di Drago.

id: \bYou're good. It's time I moved on.
en: \bYou're good. It's time I moved on.
it: \bSei forte. È ora che io vada avanti.

id: \bIt's always a bonus to feel bonded to your team.
en: \bIt's always a bonus to feel bonded to your team.
it: \bSentirsi legati alla propria squadra è sempre un vantaggio.

id: \bGive it to a friend to increase their friendship.
en: \bGive it to a friend to increase their friendship.
it: \bDallo a un amico per aumentare la sua amicizia.

id: \bSo someone finally made the trip up here.
en: \bSo someone finally made the trip up here.
it: \bE così qualcuno si è finalmente arrampicato fin quassù.

id: \bWhat a great hike that was. Can't wait to do it again.
en: \bWhat a great hike that was. Can't wait to do it again.
it: \bChe escursione fantastica. Non vedo l'ora di rifarla.
